changelog:
- Initial release of figma-user-flow-planner skill.
- Enables structured planning of user flows and screens before Figma design begins.
- Produces a complete flow map covering all screens, states (loading, error, empty), entry/exit points, and decision branches.
- Suggests a detailed Figma file structure to match the user flow.
- Includes quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure thorough, error-proof design planning.
